world.b: A projectile hit a passenger terminal at Riyadh's airport, according to Al Jazeera's live coverage of the regional war.
world.title: ‘Projectile’ hits passenger terminal at Riyadh airport

world.h: Pope Leo XIV to have lung surgery this week
world.b: Pope Leo XIV said he will have surgery this week to remove a "localized nodule" in his lung, found at a "very early stage." The operation is set for Rome's Gemelli Hospital, and the Vatican expects a weeklong recovery.
world.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week

world.h: Hurricane Simon nears Mexico at 155 mph
world.b: Hurricane Simon strengthened to 155 mph, just below Category 5, off Mexico's Pacific coast and was expected to move inland Sunday. It could bring 10 to 20 inches of rain to parts of southwestern Mexico.
world.title: Hurricane Simon nears Mexico with 155 mph winds and flooding fears

world.h: Trump weighs joining Saudi strikes on Houthis
world.b: President Trump said he is evaluating whether the U.S. should join Saudi strikes on Yemen's Houthi rebels after Riyadh's international airport was attacked again Saturday.

national.h: Dhillon reshapes DOJ's civil rights division
national.b: Over 18 months, Harmeet Dhillon has pushed out hundreds of longtime attorneys from the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division and replaced many with inexperienced ideological allies, NPR reports.
national.title: Reshaped civil rights mission at Justice Department transforms its work, workforce

national.h: DOJ probes TV networks over Trump coverage halt
national.b: The Justice Department is investigating whether TV networks violated antitrust laws by halting coverage of President Trump after the White House pulled reporters' credentials.

national.h: Hurricane Isaias kills at least 2 on Gulf Coast
national.b: Isaias hit the Gulf Coast as a Category 2 storm Friday night with 105 mph winds, snapping trees and cutting power in Florida and Alabama. Flash flood threats persist inland.

national.h: Kennedy Center names new artistic director
national.b: The Kennedy Center named talent manager Rick Canny its new artistic director despite staff complaints about his business practices as a consultant. The center has been closed since September.

national.h: DHS surveils border tribe as wall advances
national.b: ProPublica found DHS surveilled an ongoing border prayer ceremony of Arizona's Tohono O'odham Nation and questioned tribal members, after promising to engage in good faith.
national.title: As Trump’s Wall Closes in, DHS Intimidates a Border Tribe With Surveillance, Masked Agents and Drones

international.h: 139 dead as migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti
international.b: At least 139 people, including 15 children, died and 84 are missing after a boat capsized in the Gulf of Aden off Djibouti, the UN migration agency said.
international.title: At least 139 dead, 84 missing as migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti

international.h: Poland probes alleged plot to kill PM Tusk
international.b: Polish police received information about a possible plot to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz. The Interior Ministry ordered action on the matter.
international.title: Polish police probe alleged plot to assassinate PM Tusk, defence minister

international.h: Drone attack shuts Yandex data center
international.b: A Yandex data center in the Russian city of Vladimir, east of Moscow, was shut down after a drone attack. The company said no injuries were reported.
international.title: Russia’s Yandex says data centre shut down after drone attack

international.h: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
international.b: Pakistan declared a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, effectively suspending the provincial government run by jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan's PTI party.
international.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in ​province governed by Imran Khan’s party

international.h: Taiz hospitals near collapse under Houthi siege
international.b: Yemen's government warned of an imminent health catastrophe in besieged Taiz, saying medicines, IV fluids and fuel at health facilities are nearly gone.
Russian air attacks killed at least 15 people in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine's prosecutor's office said, as the US hosted talks it called productive on ending the war.

international.h: Seven killed in Gaza on 'ceasefire' anniversary
international.b: At least seven people, including an 8-year-old girl, were killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza, medical sources said, a year after the US-backed ceasefire took effect.
Police in Curitiba rescued 13 children taken hostage at a kindergarten after killing the suspect, who had threatened to set the building on fire. At least one child was hurt.

international.h: Journalist shot dead in Oaxaca, Mexico
international.b: Hamurabi Huesca Manzano, owner of the news site Pinotepa Comunica, was killed by an armed group. Article 19 says he is the ninth journalist killed in Mexico this year.

international.h: India detains thousands at youth protests
international.b: Authorities in New Delhi detained thousands as the youth 'Cockroach' movement protested a contentious voter list revision and demanded the election chief's resignation.

business.b: In a sluggish hiring environment, unemployed workers are taking longer to find new jobs, and in many cases their unemployment benefits run out first.
business.title: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one

business.h: Musk vows affordable Starlink in India
business.b: Elon Musk said he would price Starlink affordably in India to take on Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Jio, days before Jio's parent launches India's largest-ever IPO.
business.title: Musk vows ‘affordable’ Starlink in India as he escalates feud with Ambani

sports.h: Georgia still SEC's king after Week 6
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 6 overreactions: Kirby Smart's Georgia silenced Bryant-Denny Stadium, and Saturday delivered dramatic upsets and a shifted Big Ten hierarchy.
sports.title: Week 6 Overreactions: Shorthanded Georgia still sport's king, Mike Elko bites the hand that feeds him

sports.h: Oklahoma upsets No. 1 Texas in Red River
sports.b: Oklahoma beat top-ranked Texas 27-24 in Dallas as Arch Manning's late interceptions and special teams breakdowns caught up with the previously unbeaten Longhorns.
Quarterback Josh Hoover rallied the defending national champion Hoosiers from a double-digit fourth-quarter deficit to escape Nebraska's upset bid.
The Golden State Warriors and Brandin Podziemski agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension, according to multiple reports.

sports.h: Valkyries sweep Aces to reach WNBA Finals
sports.b: The second-year Golden State Valkyries beat the reigning champion Las Vegas Aces 87-77 in overtime to finish a semifinal sweep and reach their first WNBA Finals.
Mike Ditka, the Hall of Fame tight end who coached the Bears to their only Super Bowl title, has died at 86, his family said.

local.h: NJ Transit faces 5 weeks of disruptions
local.b: Starting Sunday, NJ Transit rail lines will see cancellations, new departure times and stopping changes as crews move the final track to the new $2.3 billion Portal North Bridge.
local.title: NJ Transit riders face 5 weeks of schedule disruptions starting Sunday

local.h: What we know about the ICE shooting in NYC
local.b: Police said a federal immigration officer shot and wounded 28-year-old Oscar Belgal in Marble Hill while his 5-year-old son was in the backseat, setting off anger across the city.
local.title: What we know about the ICE shooting in NYC

Northeast wind 15 to 18 mph, with gusts as high as 28 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 70%. New rainfall amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

periods.name: Columbus Day
periods.text: A chance of rain and thunderstorms before 8am, then a slight chance of showers between 8am and 11am.  Cloudy through mid morning, then gradual clearing, with a high near 70. North wind 10 to 15 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 30%.

periods.name: Monday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 60. North wind 5 to 7 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 70. Northeast wind 5 to 10 mph becoming south in the afternoon.

periods.name: Tuesday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 65.
